record.paper_title: Open problems on countable dense homogeneity
record.original_question: Is it consistent that BA(R, aleph_3) holds, where BA(X,kappa) means that any two kappa-dense subsets A and B of X can be matched by a self-homeomorphism h of X with h[A] = B?

evidence.quote: Following [88] we denote by BA(X, κ) the formally weaker property that given two κ-dense subsets A, B of a space X there is a homeomorphism h ∈ H (X) such that h[A] = B.

artifact.self_contained_problem: For a topological space $X$, let $H(X)$ denote the group of self-homeomorphisms of $X$. Given an infinite cardinal $\kappa$, a subset $A \subseteq X$ is called $\kappa$-dense in $X$ if, for every nonempty open set $U \subseteq X$, one has $|A \cap U| = \kappa$. For a space $X$ and cardinal $\kappa$, let $\mathrm{BA}(X,\kappa)$ denote the statement: for any two $\kappa$-dense subsets $A, B \subseteq X$, there exists $h \in H(X)$ with $h[A] = B$. Working in ZFC, determine whether it is consistent (relative to ZFC) that $\mathrm{BA}(\mathbb{R}, \aleph_3)$ holds, where $\mathbb{R}$ carries its usual Euclidean topology.
artifact.status_search_result: Recent literature (including work on Baumgartner's isomorphism problem for $\aleph_2$-dense suborders and 2025 papers on Baumgartner's axiom and small posets) discusses consistency at $\aleph_1$ (proved by Baumgartner) and $\aleph_2$ (studied, partial results), but no consistency proof for the $\aleph_3$ case appears. The problem is generally listed as open.

status_evidence.title: Baumgartner's axiom - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: Baumgartner proved that every two aleph-one-dense subsets of R are isomorphic is consistent.
status_evidence.claim: Consistency known for kappa = aleph_1; higher cardinals not established.

status_evidence.title: Baumgartner's axiom and small posets
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work on variants of Baumgartner's axiom, no resolution of aleph_3 case.
status_evidence.claim: No consistency result for aleph_3 cited.

status_evidence.title: Baumgartner's isomorphism problem for aleph_2-dense suborders of R
status_evidence.snippet: Studies the aleph_2 case as open problem.
status_evidence.claim: Even the aleph_2 case remains under active investigation.
